summary.text: Don Chapman is a Republican state representative from Anderson who has represented South Carolina House District 8 since November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An architect and builder, Chapman is a former Anderson city councilman and serves on the Labor, Commerce and Industry and Operations and Management committees.

paragraphs.text: Chapman was born in Yokosuka, Japan, and earned a B.A. and an M.A. from the Savannah College of Art and Design in 1989.
He has been a member of the American Institute of Architects since 2005 and was president of the Home Builders Association of Anderson in 2008 and 2014.
He served on Anderson City Council from 2008 to 2021.
Chapman took office in the House on November 14, 2022, succeeding Jonathon Hill.
In the November 3 general election he faces Democrat Demetrius Carson.
